component.name: Stirling PDF
component.summary: Powerful, privacy-focused PDF editor and toolkit

description.p: Stirling PDF is a powerful, locally hosted PDF editing platform with 50+ tools for merging, splitting, converting, signing, redacting, compressing, and performing OCR on PDF files — all without sending your documents to external services.

The desktop application provides a native Linux experience with direct PDF file association ("Open With"), offline processing for common operations, and optional connection to a self-hosted server or Stirling Cloud for advanced features like OCR and document format conversions.

ul.li: Merge, split, rotate, and reorder PDF pages
Add visual and certificate-based digital signatures
Convert between PDF and other formats (Word, Excel, images, etc.)
Compress PDFs to reduce file size
Add watermarks, headers, footers, and page numbers

screenshot.caption: Stirling PDF main interface showing available PDF tools

description.p: Desktop login bypass, comment support, timestamps, and many new features.
Read aloud feature, annotation improvements, printing fixes, and bug fixes.
Auditing improvements, search bar for settings, and various enhancements.
